description: Run before sending SOL or paying fees, to confirm the wallet has enough. Never trust a remembered balance. A wallet's SOL balance, read from the chain. Example: {"wallet": "<address>"}. Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Outputs explained: GET /api/tools/balance.

network.description: Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). "devnet" only for test wallets.

wallet.description: The wallet to read the SOL balance of. The user's address (from their wallet app) or your agent's public key. Not a .sol name or ticker.

name: balance
